3d.yes_no_account_no_api_key_no: ହଁ। କୌଣସି ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟ୍ ନାହିଁ, କୌଣସି API କି ନାହିଁ, କୌଣସି ୱାଲେଟ୍ ନାହିଁ। ମାଗଣା ଏଣ୍ଡପଏଣ୍ଟ୍ ଗୁଡିକରେ ଏକ ଉଦାର ପ୍ରତି-IP ରେଟ୍ ଲିମିଟ୍ ଅଛି ଯାହା କେବଳ ଅପବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ରୋକିଥାଏ। ମାଗଣା ଡ୍ରାଫ୍ଟ ଜେନେରେସନ୍ ଟାୟର୍ ଏକ ସେୟାର୍ଡ GPU ଲେନ୍ ଉପରେ ଚାଲିଥାଏ — ଏହା ଏକ ପ୍ରୋଟୋଟାଇପିଂ ଟାୟର୍ (ଡ୍ରାଫ୍ଟ ଜ୍ୟାମେଟ୍ରି, କେବଳ GLB, କୌଣସି ରିଗିଂ ନାହିଁ) ହେବା ବିଷୟରେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ।

agenc_embodied.paste_an_agenc_task_pda_the_avatar: ଏକ AgenC ଟାସ୍କ PDA ପେଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ। ନିମ୍ନରେ ଥିବା ଅଭାଟାର୍ଟି <three-ws-agent> ୱେବ୍ କମ୍ପୋନେଣ୍ଟ୍ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଟାସ୍କର ଅନ୍-ଚେନ୍ ସ୍ଥିତି ସହିତ ବନ୍ଧା ହୋଇଛି, ଯାହା /api/agenc/get-task କୁ ପୋଲ୍ କରେ ଏବଂ ଟାସ୍କ Open → Claimed → Completed ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଗତି କଲାବେଳେ ଦୃଶ୍ୟକୁ ପୁନଃ ରଙ୍ଗୀନ କରେ। ଅଭାଟାର୍ ଚାରିପାଖରେ ଥିବା ରଙ୍ଗୀନ ରେଡିଆଲ୍ ହାଲୋ ହେଉଛି ମୂର୍ତ୍ତିମାନ ସୂଚକ; ଯଦି ଅଭାଟାର୍ GLB ରେ ଆନିମେସନ୍ କ୍ଲିପ୍ ଅଛି, ତେବେ ଐଚ୍ଛିକ agenc-clips ଆଟ୍ରିବ୍ୟୁଟ୍ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ଥିତି ଅନୁଯାୟୀ କ୍ଲିପ୍ ବଦଳାଏ। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ଥିତି ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ AgenC ଡେଭନେଟ୍ ପ୍ରୋଗ୍ରାମ୍ 6UcJzbT…2ab ଉପରେ ଏକ ପ୍ରକୃତ Solana ଟ୍ରାଞ୍ଜାକସନ୍ ଅଟେ। agenc.tech

agi.meta_og_description: ଗୋଟିଏ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ସାଧାରଣ କୃତ୍ରିମ ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତା: pump.fun ମେମକଏନ୍ ବାଣିଜ୍ୟ। ଏହା କୌଣସି ମନୁଷ୍ୟ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅଧିକ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଲଞ୍ଚ୍, ୱାଲେଟ୍ ଗ୍ରାଫ୍ ଏବଂ ଅର୍ଡର ଫ୍ଲୋ ପଢ଼ିଥାଏ — ତା’ପରେ ନିଜେ ଆକାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରଣ କରେ, ପ୍ରବେଶ କରେ ଏବଂ ବାହାରିଯାଏ। ସେହି କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ବାହାରେ ଏହା କିଛି ଦାବି କରେ ନାହିଁ।
agi.meta_twitter_description: ପ୍ରଥମ ଏଜିଆଇ, ଡିଜାଇନ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସଂକୀର୍ଣ୍ଣ: ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱୟଂଶାସିତ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ଯିଏ ଗୋଟିଏ ଜିନିଷରେ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ମାନବ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅଧିକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ — pump.fun (Solana) ଉପରେ ମେମକଏନ୍ ବାଣିଜ୍ୟ କରିବାରେ — ଏବଂ ଜାଣିଶୁଣି ଅନ୍ୟ କିଛି ନୁହେଁ। ଏହାର ଶରୀରୀକୃତ 3D ଶରୀରକୁ ବାସ୍ତବ ସମୟରେ ବଜାର ପ୍ରତି ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରୁଥିବା ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ, ଏହା ନେଉଥିବା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତିକୁ ଏହାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ସହିତ ପଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଏହାକୁ ଏକ ଚେନ୍-ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ଟ୍ରାକ୍ ରେକର୍ଡରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ସେହି ଗୋଟିଏ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ବାହାରେ, ଏହା କିଛି ଦାବି କରେ ନାହିଁ।

alpha_copilot.pick_an_agent_it_reads_a_real: ଏକ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ଏକ ପ୍ରକୃତ ଲାଇଭ୍ ଲଞ୍ଚ୍‌କୁ ଚରିତ୍ର ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ପଢ଼େ — ଏହା ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ଦେଖିଥିବା ଲାଇଭ୍ ଲିକ୍ୱିଡିଟି, ହୋଲ୍ଡର୍, ଏବଂ ସ୍ମାର୍ଟ-ମନି ସିଗ୍ନାଲ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଉଦ୍ଧୃତ କରି — ଏବଂ ଏହାର 3D ଅବତାର ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଏହାର ରାୟକୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରରେ କୁହେ। ଯଦି ଆପଣ ଏହାର ମାଲିକ, ତେବେ ଆପଣ କଠୋର, ସର୍ଭର-ପ୍ରବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ସୀମା ମଧ୍ୟରେ କଲ୍ ଉପରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିପାରିବେ।

alpha_copilot.this_is_an_agent_s_opinion_grounded: ଏହା ଏକ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟର ମତାମତ ଯାହା ପ୍ରକୃତ ଅନ୍-ଚେନ୍ ଡାଟା ଉପରେ ଆଧାରିତ — ଆର୍ଥିକ ପରାମର୍ଶ କିମ୍ବା ଏକ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କଲ୍ ନୁହେଁ। ଏହା କହୁଥିବା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶିତ ଲାଇଭ୍ ସିଗ୍ନାଲ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସହିତ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରାଯାଏ; ମିଥ୍ୟା ତଥ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାନ କରାଯାଏ, କେବେହେଲେ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରାଯାଏ ନାହିଁ। କାର୍ଯ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକ କେବଳ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟର ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ୱାଲେଟ୍ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ ହୁଏ, ଯାହା ଏହାର ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ନୀତି ସହିତ ସଂଯୁକ୍ତ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଅଡିଟ୍ ହୋଇଛି।

arm.your_agent_needs_its_own_custodial_solan: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟକୁ ନିଜର ଏକ କଷ୍ଟୋଡିଆଲ୍ Solana ୱାଲେଟ୍ ଦରକାର, ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ଏହା ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିପାରିବ। ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ତିଆରି କରନ୍ତୁ — ଏଥିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ ଏକ ମିନିଟ୍ ଲାଗିବ — ତା’ପରେ ଏଠାକୁ ଫେରି ଏହାର ନିୟମ ସେଟ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

billing_keys.browse_paid_services_in_the_x402_bazaar: x402 ବାଜାର ରେ ପେଡ୍ ସେବାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବ୍ରାଉଜ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା x402 ଡକ୍ୟୁମେଣ୍ଟ୍ସ ପଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।
billing_keys.subscribe_through_aws_marketplace_to_bil: ଆପଣଙ୍କ AWS ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟକୁ ପେଡ୍ ଏଣ୍ଡପଏଣ୍ଟଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବିଲ୍ କରିବା ପାଇଁ AWS ମାର୍କେଟପ୍ଲେସ୍ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ସବସ୍କ୍ରାଇବ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା x402 କନସୋଲରୁ ଏକ କି ଜେନେରେଟ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।
billing_keys.we_had_trouble_reaching_the_server_check: ସର୍ଭର ସହିତ ସଂଯୋଗ କରିବାରେ ଆମକୁ ଅସୁବିଧା ହେଲା। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସଂଯୋଗ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପୁନଃ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।
billing_keys.your_x402_subscription_keys_for_calling_: ଆପଣଙ୍କର x402 ସବସ୍କ୍ରିପସନ୍ କି'ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପେଡ୍ three.ws ଏଣ୍ଡପଏଣ୍ଟଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କଲ୍ କରିବା ପାଇଁ। AWS Marketplace ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଜାରି କରାଯାଇଥିବା କି'ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଆପଣଙ୍କ AWS ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟରେ ବିଲ୍ ହେବ; ନେଟିଭ୍ କି'ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅନ୍-ଚେନ୍ ରେ ସେଟଲ୍ ହୁଏ। ସିକ୍ରେଟ୍ ଥରେ ଇସ୍ୟୁ ସମୟରେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ — ନୂଆଟିଏ ପାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଯେକୌଣସି ସମୟରେ ରୋଟେଟ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

bnb.a_card_shows_a_live_demo_the: ଗୋଟିଏ କାର୍ଡ଼ ଏକ ଲାଇଭ୍ ଡେମୋ ଦେଖାଏ ଯେତେବେଳେ ଏହାର API/ରୁଟ୍ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ରିଜଲ୍ଭ ହୁଏ — ଚାଲୁଥିବା ଡିପ୍ଲୟମେଣ୍ଟ ବିରୁଦ୍ଧରେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରାଯାଏ, ହାର୍ଡକୋଡେଡ୍ ଫ୍ଲାଗ୍ ନୁହେଁ। ଏଠାରେ କିଛି ବି 250ms ଫାଇନାଲିଟି କିମ୍ବା 20,000 TPS ଦାବି କରେ ନାହିଁ; ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ BNB ର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ରୋଡମ୍ୟାପ୍ ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି, ପଠାଯାଇଥିବା ତଥ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।

bnb.each_card_s_live_coming_soon_badge: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ କାର୍ଡ଼ର ଲାଇଭ୍/କମିଂ ସୁନ୍ ବ୍ୟାଜ୍ ଏହି ଡିପ୍ଲୟମେଣ୍ଟରେ ଏହାର API କିମ୍ବା ରୁଟ୍ ବିରୁଦ୍ଧରେ ଏକ ପ୍ରକୃତ HTTP ଯାଞ୍ଚ — ଏକ 404 କୁ "ଖୁବ୍ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଆସୁଛି" ଭାବରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଏ, ଏକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ଷମ ଏଣ୍ଡପଏଣ୍ଟ (ଏପରିକି ଯାହା କେବଳ POST ଗ୍ରହଣ କରେ) କୁ "ଲାଇଭ୍" ଭାବରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଏ।

bnb.meta_description: ଗ୍ୟାସଲେସ୍ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ଅନ୍‌ବୋର୍ଡିଂ, ଏକ ଅନ୍-ଚେନ୍-ଗେଟେଡ୍ 3D ଭଲ୍ଟ, ଏବଂ ଏକ ରିଅଲ୍-ଟାଇମ୍ ଅନ୍-ଚେନ୍ ୱାର୍ଲ୍ଡ — BNB ଚେନ୍‌ର ସର୍ବଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ 0.45s ବ୍ଲକ୍ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ମିତ ତିନୋଟି ପ୍ରଡକ୍ଟ ଟ୍ରାକ୍। ଲାଇଭ୍ ପ୍ରୁଫ୍, ଯାହା ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପଠାଯାଇ ନାହିଁ ତାହା ପାଇଁ ସଚ୍ଚୋଟ କମିଂ-ସୁନ୍ ଷ୍ଟେଟ୍।
bnb.meta_og_description: ତିନୋଟି ପ୍ରଡକ୍ଟ ଟ୍ରାକ୍ ଯାହା Ethereum L1, Base, ଏବଂ Solana ମେଳ ଖାଇପାରିବ ନାହିଁ ସେହି କ୍ଷମତାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଉପଯୋଗ କରେ — BNB ଚେନ୍‌ରେ ଲାଇଭ୍ ଭାବରେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରାଯାଇଛି। ପୃଷ୍ଠାରେ ଲାଇଭ୍ 0.45s ବ୍ଲକ୍-ଟାଇମ୍ ପ୍ରୁଫ୍ ଏମ୍ବେଡ୍ କରାଯାଇଛି।

bnb.not_20_000_tps_marketing_three_product: "20,000 TPS" ମାର୍କେଟିଂ ନୁହେଁ — ତିନୋଟି ପ୍ରଡକ୍ଟ ଟ୍ରାକ୍ ଯାହା ଆମେ 2026-07-07 ରେ BNB ଚେନ୍‌ରେ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ଭାବରେ ଲାଇଭ୍ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିଥିବା କ୍ଷମତାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଉପଯୋଗ କରେ, ଯାହା Ethereum L1, Base, ଏବଂ (ଅଧିକାଂଶ) Solana ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ମେଳ ଖାଇପାରିବ ନାହିଁ। ନିମ୍ନରେ ଥିବା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ କାର୍ଡ଼ ଆମେ ମାପିଥିବା ଦାବିକୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରେ, ଯେତେବେଳେ ଏହା ପଠାଯାଏ ସେତେବେଳେ ପ୍ରକୃତ ଡେମୋକୁ ଲିଙ୍କ୍ କରେ, ଏବଂ ଯେତେବେଳେ ଏହା ନଥାଏ ସେତେବେଳେ "ଖୁବ୍ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଆସୁଛି" — ଏକ ଡେଡ୍ ଲିଙ୍କ୍ ନୁହେଁ — ବୋଲି କୁହେ।
bnb.the_block_time_number_above_is_measured: ଉପରୋକ୍ତ ବ୍ଲକ୍-ଟାଇମ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପୃଷ୍ଠା ଲୋଡ୍‌ରେ ଏକ ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ BSC RPC ରୁ ସିଧାସଳଖ ମାପ କରାଯାଏ (probeBlockTime, ୨୦୦ ପ୍ରକୃତ ବ୍ଲକ୍ ନମୁନା କରି) — କେବେହେଲେ ହାର୍ଡକୋଡ୍ କରାଯାଇଥିବା "0.45s" ନୁହେଁ।
bnb.three_things_only_bnb_chain_lets_us: କେବଳ BNB Chain ଆମକୁ ତିଆରି କରିବାକୁ ଦେଉଥିବା ତିନୋଟି ଜିନିଷ।
bnb.three_tracks_each_honestly_gated: ତିନୋଟି ଟ୍ରାକ୍, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସଚ୍ଚୋଟ ଭାବରେ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରିତ।
bnb.we_never_claim_bnb_s_roadmap_targets: ଆମେ କେବେହେଲେ BNB ର ରୋଡମ୍ୟାପ୍ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ — ୨୦,୦୦୦ TPS, ୨୫୦ms ଫାଇନାଲିଟି (BEP-670), କିମ୍ବା ଏକ ଚେନ୍-ସ୍ତରୀୟ "AI ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ଫ୍ରେମୱାର୍କ" — କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ ହୋଇସାରିଛି ବୋଲି ଦାବି କରୁନାହୁଁ। କେବଳ ଯାହା ଆମେ ନିଜେ ମାପିଛୁ।

bnb_latency.a_chain_s_rpc_going_quiet_shows: ଏକ ଚେନ୍‌ର RPC ନିରବ ହେଲେ କେବଳ ସେହି ଲେନ୍‌ରେ "ପୁନଃସଂଯୋଗ" ଦେଖାଏ; ଦୌଡ଼ର ବାକି ଅଂଶ ଚାଲୁ ରହେ। ଚାରୋଟି ଯାକ ଏକାଥରକେ ବନ୍ଦ ହେଲେ ରିଟ୍ରାଏ ସହିତ ଏକ ଡିଜାଇନ୍ ହୋଇଥିବା ତ୍ରୁଟି ଦେଖାଏ, କେବେହେଲେ ଏକ ଖାଲି ପୃଷ୍ଠା ନୁହେଁ।
bnb_latency.each_card_samples_real_blocks_or_slots: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ କାର୍ଡ ଏକ ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ RPC ରୁ ପ୍ରକୃତ ବ୍ଲକ୍ (କିମ୍ବା Solana ପାଇଁ ସ୍ଲଟ୍) ନମୁନା କରେ ଏବଂ ମାପ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ହାରାହାରି ଅନ୍ତରାଳ ରିପୋର୍ଟ କରେ — ସ୍ପାର୍କଲାଇନ୍ ହେଉଛି ଶେଷ ୨୪ ଲାଇଭ୍ ରିଡିଂ, ସବୁଠାରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ବାର୍ = ଦ୍ରୁତତମ ମାପ।
bnb_latency.every_chain_s_public_rpc_is_unreachable: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଚେନ୍‌ର ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ RPC ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ଅପହଞ୍ଚ ଅଛି — ଏହା ଏକ ପ୍ରକୃତ ବାଧା, ଏକ ବଗ୍ ନୁହେଁ। ପୁନଃ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଅଳ୍ପ ସମୟ ପରେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ।

character_library.a_curated_library_of_professionally_rigg: ପ୍ରଫେସନାଲ୍ ଭାବରେ ରିଗ୍ଡ୍ ହ୍ୟୁମାନଏଡ୍ କ୍ୟାରେକ୍ଟରଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଏକ କ୍ୟୁରେଟେଡ୍ ଲାଇବ୍ରେରୀ। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକଟି ଏକ ସ୍କେଲିଟନ୍ ଏବଂ ସ୍କିନ୍ ୱେଟ୍ସ ସହିତ ଆସେ, ତେଣୁ ଏହା three.ws ଆନିମେସନ୍ ଲାଇବ୍ରେରୀକୁ ବାକ୍ସ ବାହାରୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବରେ ଚଳାଏ — ଆଇଡଲ୍, ୱାକ୍, ରନ୍, ୱେଭ୍, ଡ୍ୟାନ୍ସ। ଯେକୌଣସି କ୍ୟାରେକ୍ଟରକୁ ଲାଇଭ୍ ପ୍ରିଭ୍ୟୁ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏହାକୁ ଆନିମେସନ୍ ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓକୁ ପଠାନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ସିଧାସଳଖ ୱିଜେଟ୍ ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

cookbook_index.the_3d_tool_is_the_free_keyless: 3D ଟୁଲ୍ ହେଉଛି ମାଗଣା, କି-ଲେସ୍ three.ws ଟେକ୍ସଟ୍-ଟୁ-3D ଏଣ୍ଡପଏଣ୍ଟ୍। ଏହା ଏକ ଓପନ୍ ଟେକ୍ସଟ୍-ଟୁ-3D ମଡେଲ୍ (ମାଇକ୍ରୋସଫ୍ଟ TRELLIS NVIDIA NIM ଉପରେ) ଚଲାଏ ଏବଂ ଏକ ଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଡାର୍ଡ glTF 2.0 .glb ଫେରାଏ। QA ଷ୍ଟେପ୍ ସମାନ API ରୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ କି-ଲେସ୍ ଏଣ୍ଡପଏଣ୍ଟ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, ଯାହା ଯେକୌଣସି GLB କୁ ଏକ PNG ରେ ରେଣ୍ଡର୍ କରେ। କାହାକୁ ବି ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟ୍ କିମ୍ବା API କି' ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ଉଭୟ ମାଗଣାରେ ଚାଲିପାରିବ।
cookbook_index.the_critic_is_calibrated_to_the_tier: ସମାଲୋଚକ ଟାୟର୍ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ କାଲିବ୍ରେଟ୍ ହୋଇଛି। ପ୍ରଡକ୍ସନ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଡାର୍ଡ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ବିଚାର କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଏକ ଡ୍ରାଫ୍ଟ ଲେନ୍ ସବୁକିଛିରେ ଫେଲ୍ ହୁଏ, ଏବଂ ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ଉତ୍ସାହୀ ସମାଲୋଚକ 1,000-ଅକ୍ଷର ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ "ସଂଶୋଧିତ ପ୍ରମ୍ପ୍ଟ" ଲେଖେ ଯାହାକୁ ଏକ ସିଙ୍ଗଲ୍-ସବ୍ଜେକ୍ଟ ଜେନେରେଟର୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବ ନାହିଁ। ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ ପ୍ରମ୍ପ୍ଟ ସମାଲୋଚକକୁ କହିଥାଏ ଯେ ଏହି ଟାୟର୍‌ରେ ସାଧାରଣ କ'ଣ, କେବଳ ପରିଚୟ ଉପରେ ଫେଲ୍ କରିବାକୁ (ଜଣେ ଅଜଣା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁର ନାମ କହିପାରିବ କି?), ଏବଂ ଯେକୌଣସି ପୁନଃଲେଖାକୁ ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ଓ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ରଖିବାକୁ।
cookbook_index.the_free_lane_is_the_draft_tier: ମାଗଣା ଲେନ୍ ହେଉଛି ଡ୍ରାଫ୍ଟ ଟାୟର୍: ଗୋଟିଏ ବିଷୟ, ଡ୍ରାଫ୍ଟ-ଫିଡେଲିଟି ଜ୍ୟାମିତି, ରିଗିଂ ନାହିଁ। ଏଥିରେ ଏକ ସେୟାର୍ଡ GPU ଆଲୋକେସନ୍‌କୁ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ଦେଉଥିବା ଏକ ଉଦାର ପ୍ରତି-IP ରେଟ୍ ଲିମିଟ୍ ଅଛି; ସୀମା ଅତିକ୍ରମ କଲେ ଏହା 429 ସହିତ ଏକ Retry-After ହେଡର୍ ଫେରାଏ।
cookbook_index.the_helper_below_shows_a_qa_pass: ତଳେ ଥିବା ହେଲ୍ପର୍ QA ପାସ୍‌କୁ ସଚ୍ଚୋଟ ଭାବରେ ଦେଖାଏ: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ କାର୍ଡ ହେଉଛି ଠିକ୍ PNG ଯାହା ସମାଲୋଚକ ଦେଖିଥିଲା (ଇଣ୍ଟରାକ୍ଟିଭ୍ ଭ୍ୟୁଅର୍ ନୁହେଁ) ତାହା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଉତ୍ପାଦିତ ରାୟ ପାଖରେ। ଏହାକୁ କାର୍ନିଭାଲ୍ ସେଟ୍ ଉପରେ ଚଲାନ୍ତୁ:
cookbook_index.the_loop_is_the_standard_responses_api: ଲୁପ୍ ହେଉଛି ଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଡାର୍ଡ ରେସପନ୍ସେସ୍ API ଟୁଲ୍-କଲିଂ ପ୍ୟାଟର୍ନ, ଗୋଟିଏ ଅପଗ୍ରେଡ୍ ସହିତ: ମଡେଲ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ଟର୍ନରେ ଅନେକ function_call ଆଇଟମ୍ (ପ୍ରତି ପ୍ରପ୍‌ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ) ନିର୍ଗତ କରେ, ତେଣୁ ଆମେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଏକସଙ୍ଗରେ ଚଲାଉ।
cookbook_index.the_pattern_generalizes_twice_over_any_c: ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଦୁଇଥର ପ୍ରଯୁଜ୍ୟ: ମଡେଲ୍‌ରେ ଯେକୌଣସି କ୍ଷମତାର ଅଭାବ ଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ, ଆପଣ ଏହାର API କୁ ଏକ ଫଙ୍କସନ୍ ଟୁଲ୍ ଭାବରେ ରାପ୍ କରିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ତାହା ପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ହୋଇଯାଏ, ଏବଂ ଯେକୌଣସି ଜେନେରେଟିଭ୍ ଟୁଲ୍ ବିଶ୍ୱାସଯୋଗ୍ୟ ହୋଇଯାଏ ଯେତେବେଳେ ଆପଣ ଏହାର ଆଉଟପୁଟ୍‌କୁ ଏମିତି ରେଣ୍ଡର କରନ୍ତି ଯେ ମଡେଲ୍ ତାହା ଦେଖିପାରିବ ଏବଂ ନିଜ କାମକୁ ନିଜେ ଗ୍ରେଡ୍ କରିପାରିବ।
cookbook_index.the_render_clearly_depicts_a_handheld_br: ରେଣ୍ଡରଟି ଏକ ହାତରେ ଧରାଯାଉଥିବା ପିତ୍ତଳ ଲଣ୍ଠନକୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ଦର୍ଶାଉଛି, ଯାହାର ଶରୀର ସିଲିଣ୍ଡ୍ରିକାଲ୍, ହିଞ୍ଜ୍ ଥିବା ସାମ୍ନା ରିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଏବଂ ଉପର ହ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡେଲ୍ ଅଛି, ଏବଂ ଏଥିରେ ମଳିନ ପିତ୍ତଳ ଓ ନୀଳ ରଙ୍ଗର ଧୂଆଁଳିଆ କାଚ ଲାଗିଛି—ଏହା ଏକ ଭର୍ଡିଗ୍ରିସ୍ ସମୁଦ୍ରକୂଳ ଲଣ୍ଠନ ଭଳି ଦେଖାଯାଉଛି। ଏହା ପାସ୍ କରେ କାରଣ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଭିକ୍ଟୋରିଆନ୍ ସମୁଦ୍ରକୂଳ କାର୍ନିଭାଲ୍ ସୌନ୍ଦର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଚିହ୍ନଟ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ, ଯଦିଓ ଭୂତୁଣିଆ ସବୁଜ ଜ୍ୟୋତି ଏବଂ ଅଧିକ ଲୁଣ/ଭର୍ଡିଗ୍ରିସ୍ ବିବରଣୀ କିଛି ମାତ୍ରାରେ କମ୍ ଦେଖାଯାଉଛି।
cookbook_index.the_render_clearly_presents_a_warped_dri: ରେଣ୍ଡରଟି ଏକ ବଙ୍କା ହୋଇଯାଇଥିବା ଡ୍ରିଫ୍ଟଉଡ୍ ଟିକେଟ୍ ସାଇନ୍‌କୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ଦର୍ଶାଉଛି, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ଲାଲ୍ ରଙ୍ଗର ଷ୍ଟେନ୍ସିଲ୍ ଅକ୍ଷର ଛାଡ଼ିଯାଉଛି, କଳଙ୍କ ଲାଗିଥିବା ଲୁହା ବ୍ରାକେଟ୍, ଭିତରେ ଲାଗିଥିବା ସବୁଜ/ନୀଳ ସମୁଦ୍ର କାଚ, ଏବଂ ଏକ କ୍ଷୟ ହୋଇଯାଇଥିବା ବଲ୍ବ ଅଛି—ଏହା ଅନୁରୋଧ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଭୂତୁଣିଆ ସମୁଦ୍ରକୂଳ ଟିକେଟ୍ ସାଇନ୍ ଭଳି ଦେଖାଯାଉଛି ଏବଂ ଭୟାନକ, କ୍ଷୟିତ ମନୋଭାବ ସହିତ ମେଳ ଖାଉଛି।
cookbook_index.the_render_clearly_reads_as_a_small: ରେଣ୍ଡରଟି ଏକ ଛୋଟ, ପାଣିପାଗ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ କାଠ ବାକ୍ସ ଭଳି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ଦେଖାଯାଉଛି, ଯାହାର ଗୋଲାକାର ଢାଙ୍କୁଣୀ ଏବଂ ଭାରୀ, କ୍ଷୟ ହୋଇଥିବା ପୃଷ୍ଠ ବିବରଣୀ ଅଛି, ତେଣୁ ଜଣେ ଦର୍ଶକ ଏହାକୁ କେଲ୍ପ-ଟାଙ୍ଗଲ୍ଡ ପ୍ରାଇଜ୍ ଚେଷ୍ଟ୍ ଭାବରେ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିପାରିବେ। ଏହା ଡ୍ରାଫ୍ଟ ଟାୟାରରେ ପାସ୍ କରେ, ଯଦିଓ ଏଥିରେ ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ଆଭ୍ୟନ୍ତରୀଣ ପୁରସ୍କାର ଏବଂ କେଲ୍ପ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରାଣ୍ଡ୍ସର ଅଭାବ ଅଛି, ଯାହା ଏହି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଗ୍ରହଣୀୟ ତ୍ରୁଟି।
cookbook_index.the_render_depicts_a_single_triangular_r: ରେଣ୍ଡରଟି ଏକ ପାଣିପାଗ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ କାଠ ପୋଲ୍ ଉପରେ ଏକକ ତ୍ରିକୋଣୀୟ ଲାଲ୍ ପେନାଣ୍ଟ୍‌କୁ ଦର୍ଶାଉଛି, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ଲମ୍ବା ଛିଣ୍ଡା ଷ୍ଟ୍ରିମର୍ ଏବଂ ପୁରୁଣା କପଡ଼ା ଅଛି; ଯଦିଓ ବିବରଣୀ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନୁହେଁ, ତଥାପି ଏହା ଏକ ଛିଣ୍ଡା ସମୁଦ୍ରକୂଳ କାର୍ନିଭାଲ୍ ପତାକା ଭାବରେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ଦେଖାଯାଉଛି ଏବଂ ଭୂତୁଣିଆ ଭିଣ୍ଟେଜ୍ ଥିମ୍ ସହିତ ମେଳ ଖାଉଛି।
cookbook_index.the_render_is_an_indistinct_white_blob: ରେଣ୍ଡରଟି ଏକ ଅସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଧଳା ବ୍ଲବ୍, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ କୌଣସି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଡଲ୍ ସିଲୁଏଟ୍, ମୁହଁର ବୈଶିଷ୍ଟ୍ୟ, ପୋଷାକ, କିମ୍ବା ବେସ୍ ନାହିଁ—ଭାଗ୍ୟ କହିବା ଅଟୋମାଟନ୍‌ର କୌଣସି ବିବରଣୀ (ଶାଲ୍, ଆଖି, ପିତ୍ତଳ କ୍ରାଙ୍କ୍, ଟାରୋଟ୍ କାର୍ଡ) ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରାଯାଇପାରୁନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ଅଚିହ୍ନଟ ଏବଂ ଥିମ୍‌ରେ ଫେଲ୍ ହୁଏ।

crypto.the_data_api_is_the_on_ramp: ଡାଟା API ହେଉଛି ଅନ୍-ରାମ୍ପ୍। ଯେତେବେଳେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟକୁ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ — ଏକ ଟୋକେନ୍ ମିଣ୍ଟ୍ କରିବା, ଏକ ଭ୍ୟାନିଟି ଆଡ୍ରେସ୍ କ୍ଲେମ୍ କରିବା, ଏକ 3D ଆସେଟ୍ ତିଆରି କରିବା — ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ହେଉଛି ସେହି ପେଡ୍, ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ-ଶ୍ରେଣୀର ଏଣ୍ଡପଏଣ୍ଟ୍ ଯାହାକୁ ଏହା ଗ୍ରାଜୁଏଟ୍ କରେ।
crypto.the_market_snapshot_rug_check_holder_spr: ମାର୍କେଟ୍ ସ୍ନାପସଟ୍, ରଗ୍ ଚେକ୍, ହୋଲ୍ଡର୍ ସ୍ପ୍ରେଡ୍, ଲଞ୍ଚ୍ ଫିଡ୍ ଏବଂ ହ୍ୱେଲ୍ ଫ୍ଲୋ ଯାହା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ-କାର୍ଯ୍ୟରେ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ — ଗୋଟିଏ ଫେଚ୍ରେ। କୌଣସି କି ନାହିଁ, କୌଣସି ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟ୍ ନାହିଁ, କୌଣସି ପେୱାଲ୍ ନାହିଁ। Solana ଓ ବେସ୍, ପ୍ରକୃତ ଉତ୍ସ, ସଚ୍ଚୋଟ ନଲ୍।
crypto.turn_a_token_or_a_text_prompt: ଏକ ଟୋକେନ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଏକ ଟେକ୍ସଟ୍ ପ୍ରମ୍ପ୍ଟକୁ ଏକ ଟେକ୍ସଚର୍ଡ୍ GLBରେ ପରିଣତ କରନ୍ତୁ ଯାହାକୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ପିନ୍ଧିପାରିବ, ଏମ୍ବେଡ୍ କରିପାରିବ, କିମ୍ବା ARକୁ ନେଇପାରିବ।
crypto.your_agent_mints_and_launches_a_pump: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ଏକ pump.fun କଏନ୍‌କୁ ଆରମ୍ଭରୁ ଶେଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ମିଣ୍ଟ୍‌ ଓ ଲଞ୍ଚ୍‌ କରେ — ମେଟାଡାଟା, ଇମେଜ୍, କର୍ଭ୍‌ ସହିତ — ଗୋଟିଏ କଲ୍‌ରୁ।

demo_avatar_os_combined.builds_the_face_mesh_and_parents_it: ଫେସ୍ ମେଶ୍ ତିଆରି କରେ ଏବଂ ଏହାକୁ ଶରୀରର ମୁଣ୍ଡ ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ (ଯଦି ଉପସ୍ଥିତ ଥାଏ) ସଂଯୁକ୍ତ କରେ କିମ୍ବା ଶରୀରର ବାଉଣ୍ଡିଂ ବକ୍ସର ଉପର ଭାଗରେ ସ୍ଥାନିତ କରେ।

demo_avatar_os_index.embeds_the_open_source_characterstudio_m: ଓପନ୍-ସୋର୍ସ CharacterStudio (M3-org / Apache-2.0) ଏଡିଟରକୁ ଏମ୍ବେଡ୍ କରେ। ଏକ ମୂଳ ଆଭାଟାର ବାଛନ୍ତୁ, ବିଶେଷତାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କଷ୍ଟମାଇଜ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, GLB ଏକ୍ସପୋର୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ। Avaturn iframe ଏଡିଟରକୁ ବଦଳାଇଥାଏ।
demo_avatar_os_index.glb_export_uses_three_js_s_from: GLB ଏକ୍ସପୋର୍ଟ three.js ର GLTFExporter କୁ three/addons ରୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ।
demo_avatar_os_index.mediapipe_face_landmarker_apache_2_0_run: MediaPipe Face Landmarker (Apache-2.0) ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ ବ୍ରାଉଜରରେ ଚାଲେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସେଲ୍ଫିରୁ ଏକ ଟେକ୍ସଚର୍ଡ 3D ମେଶ୍ ତିଆରି କରିବା ପାଇଁ। ଏହା Avaturn ର ଫଟୋ-ଟୁ-ଅଭାତାର API କୁ ବଦଳାଏ।
demo_avatar_os_index.mediapipe_tasks_vision_pulled_via_npm_wa: npm ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଟଣାଯାଇଥିବା MediaPipe Tasks Vision (@mediapipe/tasks-vision)। WASM + ମଡେଲ ଫାଇଲଗୁଡ଼ିକ ରନଟାଇମ୍ ସମୟରେ Google ର CDN ରୁ ଫେଚ୍ ହୁଏ।
demo_avatar_os_index.stitches_the_selfie_face_mesh_onto_a: ସେଲ୍ଫି ଫେସ୍ ମେଶ୍‌କୁ ଏକ ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ବଡି GLB ଉପରେ ସିଲେଇ କରେ ଏବଂ ଏକକ ମିଶ୍ରିତ GLB ଏକ୍ସପୋର୍ଟ କରେ। ଏହା Avaturn ର ଅନ୍ତିମ ଉତ୍ପାଦର ନିକଟତମ ଅନୁରୂପ।
demo_avatar_os_index.the_avatar_studio_is_the_existing_worksp: ଅଭାତାର ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ହେଉଛି ବିଦ୍ୟମାନ character-studio/ ୱାର୍କସ୍ପେସ୍ (M3-org, AGPL — ସମୀକ୍ଷାଧୀନ), ଯାହା ଡେଭ୍ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରଡକ୍ସନରେ /avatar-studio ରେ ସମାନ-ଓରିଜିନ୍ ସର୍ଭ କରାଯାଏ। ଏହାକୁ ଥରେ npm --prefix character-studio run build ସହିତ ବିଲ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା VITE_CHARACTER_STUDIO_URL କୁ ଏକ ଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଡାଲୋନ୍ ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ସର୍ଭର ଆଡକୁ ଦର୍ଶାନ୍ତୁ।
demo_avatar_os_index.three_parallel_paths_replace_what_we_cur: ତିନୋଟି ସମାନ୍ତରାଳ ପଥ Avaturn ରୁ ଆମେ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ଯାହା ପାଉଛୁ ତାହାକୁ ବଦଳାଏ। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଡେମୋ ଏଣ୍ଡ-ଟୁ-ଏଣ୍ଡ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ଷମ — କ୍ୟାପଚର୍, ଜେନେରେଟ୍, ପ୍ରିଭ୍ୟୁ, ଏକ୍ସପୋର୍ଟ GLB। କୌଣସି ମକ୍ ନାହିଁ, କୌଣସି ନକଲି ଡାଟା ନାହିଁ।
demo_avatar_os_index.triangulation_indices_from_tfjs_models_a: tfjs-models (Apache-2.0) ରୁ ଟ୍ରାଇଆଙ୍ଗୁଲେସନ୍ ଇଣ୍ଡେକ୍ସ — src/demo/triangulation.js ରେ ଭେଣ୍ଡର୍ କରାଯାଇଛି।

demo_avatar_os_selfie.front_facing_photo_gives_the_best_face: ସମ୍ମୁଖ ଭାଗର ଫଟୋ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଫେସ୍ ମେଶ୍ ଦିଏ। ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱ ଫଟୋଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଐଚ୍ଛିକ (ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସନ୍ଦର୍ଭ ପାଇଁ ମିଳିତ ଡେମୋ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବ୍ୟବହୃତ)।
demo_avatar_os_selfie.runs_the_mediapipe_face_landmarker_on_th: ସମ୍ମୁଖ ଫଟୋ ଉପରେ MediaPipe Face Landmarker ଚଲାଏ। ଏକ three.js BufferGeometry ତିଆରି କରେ: ଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡମାର୍କରୁ 478 ଭର୍ଟେକ୍ସ ପୋଜିସନ୍, ଇମେଜ୍ କୋଅର୍ଡରୁ UVs, tfjs-models ଟ୍ରାଇଆଙ୍ଗୁଲେସନ୍ (Apache-2.0, ଭେଣ୍ଡର୍ଡ) ରୁ ଇଣ୍ଡେକ୍ସ।

demo_avatar_os_studio.any_window_postmessage_from_the_iframe_o: ଏହି ଆକୃତି ସହିତ iframe ଓରିଜିନରୁ ଯେକୌଣସି window.postMessage କ୍ୟାପଚର୍ କରାଯାଏ।
demo_avatar_os_studio.in_characterstudio_click_export_vrm_or_g: CharacterStudio ରେ, Export · VRM କିମ୍ବା GLB ଉପରେ କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏହି ପୃଷ୍ଠା ଏକ୍ସପୋର୍ଟ ମେସେଜ୍ ପାଇଁ ଶୁଣେ ଏବଂ ଫଳାଫଳକୁ ତଳେ ରେଣ୍ଡର କରେ।
demo_avatar_os_studio.loads_the_three_ws_avatar_studio_in: ଏକ iframe ରେ three.ws ଆଭାଟାର ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ଲୋଡ୍ କରେ — /avatar-studio ରେ ସମାନ ଉତ୍ସରୁ ପରିବେଷଣ କରାଯାଏ ((VITE_CHARACTER_STUDIO_URL ସହିତ ଓଭରରାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ)) — କିମ୍ବା ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ CharacterStudio ବିଲ୍ଡ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

demo_coin_index.every_holder_is_a_ticket_hourly_draws: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଧାରକ ଏକ ଟିକେଟ୍। ଘଣ୍ଟା ପ୍ରତି ଡ୍ର'ରେ SOL ରେ ଲଟେରୀ ପାଣ୍ଠି ଏକ ଯାଦୃଚ୍ଛିକ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ୱାଲେଟକୁ ପଠାଯାଏ। ଡ୍ର' ମଧ୍ୟରେ, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଧାରକ ଏକ ନିଷ୍କ୍ରିୟ SOL ରିଫ୍ଲେକ୍ସନ୍ ପାଆନ୍ତି ଯାହା ସିଧାସଳଖ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ୱାଲେଟକୁ ପୈଠ କରାଯାଏ — ଯାହା ମୂଳ ଟୋକେନ୍ ଉପରେ ଟ୍ରେଡିଂ ଫି' ଦ୍ୱାରା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ରୂପେ ପାଣ୍ଠି ଯୋଗାଇ ଦିଆଯାଏ, three.ws ଶେଷରୁ ଶେଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଯାଞ୍ଚଯୋଗ୍ୟ ଯାଦୃଚ୍ଛିକତା।
demo_coin_index.meta_description: ଡେମୋ — three.ws ଲଟେରୀ + SOL ରିଫ୍ଲେକ୍ସନ୍ ମେକାନିକ୍, ପରୀକ୍ଷଣାଧୀନ। ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଉତ୍ପାଦନ ଲଞ୍ଚ୍ ହୋଇନାହିଁ।

demos_audio2face.powered_by_nvidia_audio2face_3d_over_nvc: Powered by /api/a2f (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D over NVCF gRPC) and /api/tts/speak (NVIDIA Magpie). The blendshape→morph mapping lives in src/voice/a2f-player.js — it reuses the ARKit/VRM/Oculus vocabulary in src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js, so any humanoid rig lip-syncs without a per-rig allowlist. See the amplitude-only lipsync demo for the fallback path on its own.
demos_audio2face.two_nvidia_models_on_one_face: Two NVIDIA models on one face
demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Type a line. It's spoken in NVIDIA Magpie's voice, and that exact audio is sent to NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, which returns a per-frame ARKit blendshape track. The avatar's mouth and face animate frame-for-frame with the real voice — mapped onto whatever morph-target convention the loaded GLB ships (ARKit, common avatar-platform, VRM, Oculus visemes). If Audio2Face is unavailable, the avatar still speaks and falls back to amplitude lipsync — never a frozen face.

demos_avatar_sdk.the_npm_sdk_bundle_loaded_from_what: The npm SDK bundle loaded from /avatar-sdk/dist/index.mjs (what consumers would get from npm install @three-ws/avatar once it's published). On mount it registers <agent-3d> as a custom element. The Creator section opens the iframe modal that resolves with a GLB Blob — the same flow third-party sites would use.
demos_avatar_sdk.the_sdk_resolves_against_on_the_same: The SDK resolves avatar-id against GET /api/avatars/:id on the same origin the SDK was loaded from (override with api-base="https://other.host"). This is the durable handoff the gallery picker emits, and it keeps working even if the underlying GLB URL changes.

demos_bonding_curve.interactive_bancor_v1_simulator_the_same: Interactive Bancor V1 simulator (the same formula pump.fun uses). Everything runs in the browser — no wallet, no on-chain writes, no RPC. Move the sliders, simulate buys and sells against a virtual reserve, and watch the spot price respond. Useful for sizing the reserve ratio and graduation threshold before deploying real agent tokens.
demos_bonding_curve.same_starting_state_same_cumulative_eth_: Same starting state, same cumulative ETH deposited — three different reserve ratios. Lower ratio = steeper curve = faster price discovery + more aggressive front-runner advantage. Pump.fun ships ~25% by default.

demos_livepeer_inference.meta_description: Same prompt, two providers. Compare three.ws default inference against a decentralized AI gateway side-by-side: latency, token counts, and the full reply from each.
demos_livepeer_inference.powered_by_livepeer_ai_gateway_on_the: Powered by Livepeer AI Gateway on the decentralized side. Claude reply provided by Anthropic. The public decentralized gateway is rate-limited and occasionally slow — typical p50 latency is 2–10 s for an 8B-param model.
demos_livepeer_inference.same_prompt_two_providers_real_responses: Same prompt, two providers, real responses. The left card hits three.ws's default inference (Claude). The right card routes the identical request through a decentralized AI gateway whose orchestrators run open-weight models on commodity GPUs. Phase 4 of the roadmap: decoupling inference from any single vendor so agents stay online when one provider doesn't.

Both routes run server-side on three.ws.

docs_walk_analytics.anonymous_walkers_count_too_signed_in_wa: Anonymous walkers count too. Signed-in walkers are attributed to their account; everyone else is keyed to a rotating anonymous id, so the leaderboard and your totals still include them.

docs_walk_analytics.each_event_posts_immediately_events_are_: Each event posts immediately (events are sparse, unlike the batched metrics) and is attributed to the same avatar and walker as the surrounding session. The dashboard shows each event's count and its conversion rate against sessions.

All figures come from real walk activity; nothing is sampled or estimated.

docs_walk_analytics.metres_walked_summed_from_per_frame_move: Metres walked, summed from per-frame movement.
docs_walk_analytics.no_third_party_tracking_metrics_flow_onl: No third-party tracking. Metrics flow only to the three.ws ingest; there is no external analytics provider in the pipeline.
docs_walk_analytics.owner_only_the_dashboard_api_requires_a: Owner-only. The dashboard API requires a signed-in session (or a bearer token with the avatars:read scope) and verifies you own the avatar — others get a 403.
docs_walk_analytics.per_day_sessions_distance_and_duration_g: Per-day sessions, distance, and duration — gaps filled with zeroes for a continuous chart.
docs_walk_analytics.sessions_counted_across_the_selected_win: Sessions counted across the selected window.
docs_walk_analytics.the_embed_host_which_site_the_avatar: The embed host (which site the avatar walked on) is derived server-side from the request's Origin/Referer header — never trusted from the request body. Your "unique origins" reflect where the avatar actually ran.
docs_walk_analytics.the_ingest_accepts_this_batch_all_fields: The ingest accepts this batch (all fields optional unless noted):
docs_walk_analytics.the_runtime_unlocks_a_fixed_set_of: The runtime unlocks a fixed set of achievements, persisted once each:
docs_walk_analytics.the_top_10_embed_hosts_by_session: The top 10 embed hosts by session count.
docs_walk_analytics.the_walk_runtime_accumulates_two_running: The walk runtime accumulates two running totals — horizontal distance and session wall-clock — and flushes a compact batch to POST /api/walk/metrics roughly every 60 seconds, plus once on page hide via navigator.sendBeacon. One batch becomes a single per-day rollup row, so an hour of walking is a handful of rows, not thousands.
docs_walk_analytics.your_conversion_events_with_a_count_and: Your conversion events with a count and conversion rate (events ÷ sessions).

docs_walk_chrome_extension.fetch_your_avatars_featured_avatars_and_: Fetch your avatars, featured avatars, and TTS voices, and serve the walking iframe.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.reads_pages_aloud_optional_with_narratio: Reads pages aloud (optional). With narration enabled, it detects the main article, tracks what's in view, and speaks visible sections using text-to-speech.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.requires_chrome_109_or_newer_manifest_v3: Requires Chrome 109 or newer (Manifest V3). To package a store-ready zip, run npm run build:extension:prod, which emits dist/extension-<version>.zip.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.respects_your_rules_per_site_enabling_pl: Respects your rules. Per-site enabling plus an allowlist/blocklist, and it never auto-injects — it runs only where you ask.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.small_medium_large_or_custom_width_heigh: Small, Medium, Large, or custom width × height.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_is_built_from_this_reposit: The extension is built from this repository and loaded unpacked. (It is prepared for the Chrome Web Store; a public listing is not yet available, so install it in developer mode.)
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_requests_the_minimum_it_ne: The extension requests the minimum it needs and injects only on explicit user action.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_three_ws_walk_avatar_extension_v1: The three.ws Walk Avatar extension (v1.0.0) puts a floating 3D avatar on any website you visit. It walks alongside you and can read page sections aloud — a living browsing companion. It only ever runs on tabs you explicitly enable.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.with_narration_on_the_extension_parses_t: With narration on, the extension parses the page's main article (using a bundled Readability extractor), pulls out headings, paragraphs, list items, and blockquotes, and watches which section is in view. When a section becomes the focus it requests speech audio from the three.ws text-to-speech service and plays it, while telling the avatar to show a speech bubble and switch to an idle pose. You choose the voice, can mute mid-read, and narration honours prefers-reduced-motion. Authors can mark sections with data-walk-narrate (or skip them with data-walk-narrate="skip").

docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_a_three_ws_site: Companion mode is a three.ws-site feature. To put a walking avatar on your own site, use the one-tag JavaScript SDK; to walk your avatar on every site you visit, install the Chrome extension.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_platform_integrati: Companion mode is the platform integration of the publishable walk SDK. The three.ws navigation injects the companion script only when the companion is enabled — a page that never turns it on pays nothing for it. Under the hood it loads the avatar's pre-baked animation manifest and the same rendering engine the walk page and embeds use.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_site_wide_walking: Companion mode is the site-wide walking avatar on three.ws. Turn it on and your avatar detaches from the page chrome, walks around the screen, and follows you as you move between pages — complete with walk-aware page transitions.
docs_walk_companion_mode.detaches_and_roams_your_avatar_leaves_th: Detaches and roams. Your avatar leaves the page layout and becomes a free 3D character you can watch walk around.
docs_walk_companion_mode.edit_this_page_on_github: ✎ Edit this page on GitHub
docs_walk_companion_mode.follows_you_between_pages_when_you_navig: Follows you between pages. When you navigate, the companion persists — and walk-aware page transitions dress the jump to match where you're going.
docs_walk_companion_mode.meta_description: Companion mode: a site-wide three.ws avatar that detaches from the page, walks around, and follows you between pages — with walk-aware page transitions and wave-goodbye / wave-hello.
docs_walk_companion_mode.nav_button_the_walk_control_in_the: Nav button — the Walk control in the top navigation toggles the companion on and off. The preference is remembered across visits.

docs_walk_companion_mode.programmatically_the_companion_instance_: Programmatically — the companion instance is available at window.__walkCompanion once enabled (this is the interface the navigation drives).
docs_walk_companion_mode.query_parameter_append_to_any_three_ws: Query parameter — append ?walk=1 to any three.ws URL to force it on, or ?walk=0 to force it off.
docs_walk_companion_mode.the_companion_and_its_page_transitions_r: The companion and its page transitions respect prefers-reduced-motion. The roaming avatar is decorative; all navigation and content remain fully usable with the companion off, which is the default state until you opt in.
docs_walk_companion_mode.waves_goodbye_and_hello_on_a_link: Waves goodbye and hello. On a link click the avatar plays a wave and sets a one-shot flag the destination page reads to wave back when it loads.

docs_walk_embed_api.everything_inbound_is_validated_numbers_: Everything inbound is validated. Numbers are clamped, strings are length-bounded, enums are checked, and config.bg is restricted to safe color forms. A bad command yields a walk:error, never a throw.

docs_walk_embed_api.nothing_internal_leaks_outbound_messages: Nothing internal leaks. Outbound messages carry only the fields in the tables above — never session tokens, avatar source URLs, or scene state. A live avatar swap reports the public avatarId you gave it, not the resolved CDN URL.
docs_walk_embed_api.origin_allow_listing_is_opt_in_the: Origin allow-listing is opt-in. The embed ships frame-ancestors * so it drops onto any site, so inbound is allow-any by default. Pin it with ?allowOrigins=https://your.site (and ?targetOrigin= to pin where events are posted) when you know the exact host.

docs_walk_embed_api.render_the_iframe_then_wrap_it_with: Render the iframe, then wrap it with the SDK to get a clean, promise-free command and event API:
docs_walk_embed_api.send_these_to_drive_the_avatar_with: Send these to drive the avatar. With the SDK, each maps to a method; over raw postMessage, send the typed envelope (see Envelope). Every command is validated and clamped inside the iframe before it touches the avatar.
docs_walk_embed_api.source_is_the_real_authentication_the_if: Source is the real authentication. The iframe only accepts commands whose source window is its own parent; the SDK only accepts events whose source is the iframe it wraps. Spoofed origins can't inject either way.

docs_walk_embed_api.the_avatar_moves_throttled_to_10_hz: The avatar moves. Throttled to ≤ 10 Hz; heading is the facing yaw in radians.

docs_walk_postmessage_events.the_embed_is_designed_to_run_on: The embed is designed to run on any origin (it ships frame-ancestors *), so the host's origin cannot be allow-listed in advance. The real authentication is the message source: the iframe only accepts messages from its own parent window, and the host SDK only accepts messages from the iframe it mounted. As a belt-and-suspenders filter, a security-conscious integrator can pass an explicit allowOrigins list to the embed when the exact origin is known.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.the_host_page_and_the_iframe_talk: The host page and the /walk-embed iframe talk over window.postMessage. This is the wire contract: the message envelope, the commands you send in, the events the iframe sends back, and how origins are handled.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.the_legacy_flat_shape_a_bare_with: The legacy flat shape — a bare { type: 'walk:*' } with no channel/v — is still accepted inbound for backward compatibility with embeds shipped before this contract existed. New integrations should use the channelled envelope.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.using_the_javascript_sdk_it_does_the: Using the JavaScript SDK? It does the source check, channel guard, and event forwarding for you — just call ThreeWalkAvatar.on('walk:ready', …).
docs_walk_postmessage_events.when_you_listen_for_events_on_the: When you listen for events on the host side, always verify event.source === iframe.contentWindow before trusting a message, and check data.channel === 'three-walk' (or that the bare type is a known walk:* event).

eth_vanity.create2_fixes_the_deployer_address_and_t: CREATE2 fixes the deployer address and the init code; only the salt is yours to choose.
eth_vanity.grind_a_vanity_smart_contract_address_by: Grind a vanity smart-contract address by searching CREATE2 salts — no private keys involved. The result is a deterministic address you can deploy to from your factory of choice (Safe, ERC-4337 SimpleAccount, CreateX, Coinbase Smart Wallet…). Runs entirely in your browser.
eth_vanity.hex_characters_only_0_9_a_f: Hex characters only (0–9, a–f). Each extra character is 16× harder. Mixed case (e.g. Beef) matches the EIP-55 checksum — visually distinctive, ~2× harder per letter.
eth_vanity.if_you_have_the_raw_deploy_bytecode: If you have the raw initCode (deploy bytecode + constructor args), paste it below and we'll hash it for you.

eth_vanity.meta_twitter_description: Grind a vanity smart-contract address by searching CREATE2 salts — chain-agnostic and deployer-agnostic. Works with any CREATE2 factory. Runs entirely in your browser, no private keys involved.

evm_wallet.grind_a_real_ethereum_evm_wallet_whose: Grind a real Ethereum / EVM wallet whose address starts or ends with characters of your choice — for your agent, treasury, or anywhere a memorable 0x address matters. The result is a normal secp256k1 keypair you can import into MetaMask, ethers, viem or Rabby. Runs entirely in your browser. The private key is never transmitted anywhere.
evm_wallet.hex_characters_only_0_9_a_f: Hex characters only (0–9, a–f). Each extra character is 16× harder. Mixed case (e.g. BeeF) matches the EIP-55 checksum — visually distinctive, ~2× harder per letter.
evm_wallet.meta_description: Grind a custom Ethereum / EVM wallet address with the prefix or suffix of your choice. A real secp256k1 keypair — importable into MetaMask, ethers, viem. Runs entirely in your browser; the private key never leaves your device.
evm_wallet.meta_og_description: Grind a custom Ethereum / EVM wallet address in your browser. A real keypair, importable into MetaMask. Keys never leave your device.
evm_wallet.meta_twitter_description: Grind a custom Ethereum / EVM wallet address in your browser. Keys never leave your device.
evm_wallet.this_is_an_eoa_grinder_it_searches: This is an EOA grinder — it searches private keys directly, so you own the resulting address. (CREATE2 is the sibling tool for vanity smart-contract addresses, where you grind a salt instead of a key.) Keys are generated with your browser's CSPRNG, each match is re-derived and verified before it's shown, and the export below is an encrypted keystore by default.

features.why_it_s_better_any_llm_works: Why it's better: Any LLM works via MCP or A2A — Claude, GPT, Gemini, or your own. No vendor lock-in.
features.why_it_s_better_every_avatar_and: Why it's better: Every avatar and agent you create shows up here automatically — nothing to wire up, one login for all of it.
features.why_it_s_better_it_s_a: Why it's better: It's a real launch with live trading from the first second — you supply the details, we handle the on-chain mechanics.
features.why_it_s_better_no_app_install: Why it's better: No app install — it runs in the browser with real physics (Rapier) and real terrain, not a flat plane.
features.why_it_s_better_no_sdk_required: Why it's better: No SDK required on the consumer side — one tag, any page, no build step.
features.why_it_s_better_outputs_are_glb: Why it's better: Outputs are GLB-ready — load them straight into the viewer, deploy, or embed without any conversion step.
features.why_it_s_better_pay_per_call: Why it's better: Pay-per-call means no subscriptions to manage — buyers pay exactly what they use, and you get paid per call.
features.why_it_s_better_real_on_chain: Why it's better: Real on-chain settlement via pay-per-call (micropayments) — every transaction is verifiable, not simulated.
features.why_it_s_better_sub_cent_fees: Why it's better: Sub-cent fees. You hold the keys. The agent card is a public JSON URL — nothing is locked to this site.
features.why_it_s_better_the_rig_is: Why it's better: The rig is animation-ready — you can load it straight into the viewer and trigger any animation immediately.
features.why_it_s_better_these_are_real: Why it's better: These are real Granite API calls — not mocked — with every decision anchored to a Solana transaction as an immutable record.
features.why_it_s_better_three_ar_methods: Why it's better: Three AR methods in one button — iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, and WebXR. The right one fires automatically. The agent stays live in WebXR, so conversation and animations work in AR.

features_agent_exchange.built_on_the_open_x402_http_payment: Built on the open x402 HTTP payment standard — any HTTP client that supports the 402 / payment-proof handshake can become a buyer or seller in this economy.
features_agent_exchange.every_transaction_appears_in_the_live_fe: Every transaction appears in the live feed panel with the Solana tx hash, amount in USDC, and confirmation status. You can verify any transaction on Solana Explorer independently.
features_agent_exchange.meta_description: Watch two AI agents with 3D avatars negotiate and pay each other for crypto intelligence using x402 micropayments on Solana. Every transaction confirmed on-chain — live.

features_agent_exchange.neither_agent_is_simulated_both_hold_sol: Neither agent is simulated. Both hold Solana wallets funded with real USDC. Every payment is a confirmed on-chain transaction — not a mock or a ledger entry.
features_agent_exchange.nova_s_endpoint_responds_with_a_402: NOVA's endpoint responds with a 402 Payment Required and a price quote. ORACLE's wallet approves the payment, signs a Solana transaction, and retries the request — NOVA verifies the on-chain settlement and returns the data.
features_agent_exchange.open_the_agent_exchange_and_see_every: Open the Agent Exchange and see every on-chain transaction happen in real time.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_are_two_ai_agents: ORACLE and NOVA are two AI agents with 3D avatars and real Solana wallets. They autonomously buy and sell crypto intelligence from each other via x402 micropayments — every transaction confirmed on-chain, visible in real time.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_have_distinct_3d_avatars: ORACLE and NOVA have distinct 3D avatars, voices, and on-chain identities — you see them as entities negotiating, not as faceless API calls.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_decides_it_needs_crypto_market_da: ORACLE decides it needs crypto market data. It discovers NOVA as a data provider on the x402 service catalog and issues a paid API request — a standard HTTP call with a payment proof header.
features_agent_exchange.the_three_ws_agent_sdk_implements_the: The three.ws agent SDK implements the full x402 flow out of the box. Any agent you build can call paid skills and earn from exposing its own skills — the same infrastructure ORACLE and NOVA use.

features_deploy.because_the_identity_is_an_nft_it: Because the identity is an NFT, it can be transferred or sold. Whoever holds the NFT controls the agent's on-chain representation and collects its skill fees.
features_deploy.click_deploy_the_ui_previews_the_transac: Click Deploy. The UI previews the transaction and metadata before you sign. Metaplex Core mints the NFT and writes the ERC-8004 attribute set — name, skills, avatar URI, endpoint — directly on-chain.
features_deploy.every_agent_minted_through_three_ws_carr: Every agent minted through three.ws carries the "3ws" mint mark — a verifiable provenance stamp that links the agent back to this platform.
features_deploy.fill_in_your_agent_s_name_description: Fill in your agent's name, description, skill tags, and avatar in the Deploy UI. Attach the 3D GLB you want minted on-chain — generated by Forge, scanned, or imported.
features_deploy.meta_description: Register your AI agent on Solana via ERC-8004 and Metaplex Core. Mint its 3D avatar as an on-chain NFT, lock in metadata, and make it discoverable by any other agent — forever.

features_deploy.on_chain_attestations_accumulate_on_the_: On-chain attestations accumulate on the same NFT — skill endorsements, usage volume, and verified identity badges are part of the permanent record.
features_deploy.other_agents_resolve_your_identity_from_: Other agents resolve your identity from on-chain data and call your skills without a central registry — permissionless, censorship-resistant agent-to-agent communication.
features_deploy.permanent_verifiable_discoverable_on_sol: Permanent, verifiable, discoverable — on Solana mainnet in a few seconds.
features_deploy.register_your_ai_agent_on_solana_via: Register your AI agent on Solana via the ERC-8004 standard. Metaplex Core mints its 3D avatar and metadata as an on-chain NFT — locked, verifiable, and discoverable by any wallet or other agent, forever.
features_deploy.your_agent_appears_instantly_in_the_erc: Your agent appears instantly in the ERC-8004 on-chain directory at /discover and gets a /.well-known/agent-card.json endpoint. Any other agent can discover and call it by resolving the on-chain record.

features_forge.attach_the_glb_to_any_ai_agent: Attach the GLB to any AI agent on three.ws so the agent gets a custom 3D body instead of a default avatar.
features_forge.describe_what_you_want_a_ceramic_coffee: Describe what you want — "a ceramic coffee mug with blue glaze," "a rusted iron sword," anything. Be specific about material and style for best results.

features_forge.flux_renders_a_detailed_texture_image_fr: Flux renders a detailed texture image from your text. TRELLIS lifts that image into a full 3D mesh with UV-mapped textures, all in one pipeline run.
features_forge.forge_runs_flux_image_generation_and_tre: Forge runs Flux image generation and TRELLIS 3D reconstruction back-to-back. Describe any object and walk away with a textured GLB you can orbit in AR, embed anywhere, or attach to your AI agent.
features_forge.inspect_the_result_in_the_in_browser: Inspect the result in the in-browser viewer, download the GLB, share a link, or pin it to your AI agent as its 3D body — all from the same page.

ibm_hello.three_is_the_native_coin_of_three: $THREE is the native coin of three.ws, used to pay across the platform alongside USDC. It's the only coin three.ws issues. Contract address: FeMbDoX7R1Psc4GEcvJdsbNbZA3bfztcyDCatJVJpump on Solana.

You describe a character in plain language and get a textured, rigged avatar that walks, poses, and lives in shared 3D worlds — running in any browser, no install. ibm_hello.x402_revives_the_dormant_http_402_paymen: x402 revives the dormant HTTP 402 Payment Required status as a real payment rail. You call an endpoint normally; if it's paid, the server answers 402 with an exact price, asset, and address. Your wallet signs a gasless authorization, you resend with an X-PAYMENT header, and the call settles on-chain — all in one round trip, no account or API key.
ibm_hello.yes_the_paid_demos_move_real_funds: Yes. The paid demos move real funds from your own wallet — USDC, or $THREE on Solana — and settle on Base or Solana mainnet. Nothing is simulated and nothing is mocked; the price you see is read live from the server's own 402 response, and you get an on-chain settlement receipt.

ibm_hello.you_ll_get_back_price_24_hour: You'll get back price, 24-hour change, market cap, liquidity, 24-hour volume, and a signal with a short rationale — live from DexScreener. Settles in USDC or $THREE on Solana (USDC on Base); the network fee is sponsored by the facilitator.
ibm_hello.you_ll_need_the_phantom_wallet_on: You'll need the Phantom wallet on Solana — holding the model's price in USDC, or the equivalent in $THREE, on Solana mainnet. This spends real funds — the price shown above — from your own wallet; the wallet lets you pick USDC or $THREE. The payment itself is a gasless signature: the network fee is sponsored by the x402 facilitator, so it isn't added to your cost. Generation runs once the payment verifies and takes roughly a minute. No wallet? Forge one free below — no wallet, no key, no payment.
ibm_hello.you_sign_a_gasless_usdc_authorization_re: You sign a gasless USDC authorization, resend with an X-PAYMENT header, and the call settles on-chain — your data comes back.

integrity.agent_wallets_on_three_ws_are_custodial: Agent wallets on three.ws are custodial — we hold the keys and sign on your behalf. So we make custody provable, not promised. Every few hours we snapshot every wallet's on-chain state, build a Merkle tree, and commit the root to Solana. Below is the latest root and its anchoring transaction — verify it on-chain yourself. Own a wallet? Verify your own inclusion proof →
integrity.meta_description: three.ws custodial agent wallets are provably honest. Every few hours the platform commits a Merkle root over every wallet's on-chain state to Solana. Verify the latest root on-chain yourself — no account, no trust required.

launch_week.1_010_members_in_the_x_community:
1,010 members in the X community.
From zero. In a week.
launch_week.267_8k_impressions_25_3k_engagements_9: 267.8K impressions. 25.3K engagements. 9.4% engagement rate. 5.1K profile visits. 7.2K likes, 1.5K reposts, 845 replies, 198 bookmarks, 61 shares. Reply-to-like ratio: 11.7% — well into live-conversation territory. Verified followers: 359. Following: 11.
launch_week.a_real_time_3d_agent_runtime_on: A real-time 3D agent runtime on Three.js + glTF. Multi-provider chat (Claude, GPT, Groq, OpenRouter) with sentiment-driven emotion. Native Solana wallet integration. Pump.fun trading skills as agent tools. Reverse-engineered the entire pump-fun-agent-payments-sdk — Anchor IDL, PDAs, event parsing, x402 layer — now editable source. Solana vanity grinder. Pump.fun create-coin co-signer. Live pump.fun feed.
launch_week.a_week_of_building_in_public: A week of building in public
launch_week.anthropic_claude_openai_gpt_groq_openrou: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Groq, OpenRouter — all behind one chat interface with real-time streaming via Server-Sent Events. The agent reads user sentiment and reacts with emotion + animation. Function calls, MCP tool use, artifacts. 100% open source.
launch_week.april_29_2026_nichxbt_posted_three_ws: April 29, 2026. @nichxbt posted three.ws — the open-source platform for 3D AI agents that talk, remember, hold wallets, and mint on-chain. 135,000 views in the first 24 hours. Same day: npm package live, listed on Anthropic's MCP Registry, listed on x402scan as a paid endpoint, native Pump.fun trading skills shipped, Solana vanity address generator deployed, voice + X Spaces agent demo.
launch_week.asymmetric_posture_is_a_signal_following: Asymmetric posture is a signal. Following 11. Followed by 3,675. The numbers say: we are a publisher, not a follow-back farm. Verified followers (359, ~10%) skew toward power users — exactly the cohort that pays for, builds with, and amplifies what we ship next.
launch_week.beyond_the_analytics_dashboard_three_ws_: Beyond the analytics dashboard, three.ws landed on the directories, registries, and platforms that matter most for an open-source developer tool.
launch_week.cloud_infra_googlecloud_web3_startups_pr: Cloud + infra: @GoogleCloud (Web3 Startups program), @alibaba_cloud (Marketplace listing). Exchanges: @Coinbase + @CoinbaseWallet, @Bybit_Official, @JupiterExchange, @CoinGecko, @CoinMarketCap, Investing.com.
launch_week.copy_pasteable_version_below_every_metri: Copy-pasteable version below — every metric framed positively, designed for direct posting.
launch_week.cross_pollinated_authors_compound_the_we: Cross-pollinated authors compound. The week's biggest individual post (135K views) came from @nichxbt, not @trythreews. The May 7 RT from @zhusu (50K views) was earned by the work, not the brand handle. Use both — founder voice for narrative, brand for ecosystem announcements.
launch_week.day_by_day_every_milestone_that_landed: Day by day: every milestone that landed
launch_week.drag_and_drop_glb_viewer_with_pbr: Drag-and-drop GLB viewer with PBR rendering, IBL environments, postprocessing (bloom, tone mapping, FXAA). three.ws Studio for avatar and animation editing. 32-animation interactive demo. Procedural idle, lip-sync, sentiment-driven emotion. One-line embed via <agent-3d> web component.
launch_week.each_name_below_was_earned_in_the: Each name below was earned in the same week. Every link is a public listing or announcement.
launch_week.elevenlabs_edge_tts_for_agent_voice_demo: ElevenLabs + Edge TTS for agent voice. Demo of an agent autonomously joining a live X Space, requesting speaker access, listening, and responding. WebSocket event subscription — payment received → celebration animation; buyback fires → agent reacts live; withdrawal → logged to identity timeline.
launch_week.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_from_3_10_secon: ElevenLabs voice cloning from 3–10 seconds of speech, persona extraction from a short onboarding interview, and consented memory seeding from connected accounts — the avatar isn't just you, the agent acts like you.
launch_week.erc_8004_agent_registration_on_evm_solan: ERC-8004 agent registration on EVM. Solana attestations on six event types: feedback, validation, task offers, task acceptance, revocation, dispute. ERC-7710 scoped delegations — grant/revoke time-bound, amount-limited permissions. Full reputation crawl every 5 minutes via cron.
launch_week.erc_8004_on_chain_identity_chat_panel: @three-ws/sdk — ERC-8004 on-chain identity, chat panel, ERC-7710 scoped delegations, IPFS pinning, browser wallet integration. @three-ws/agent-payments v3.1.0 — agent payment program with v2 bonding curve support, x402 facilitator, EVM agent payments (Base + Arbitrum), event parsers. three.ws — npm package for the <agent-3d> web component.

launch_week.native_solana_wallet_integration_agents_: Native Solana wallet integration — agents hold and spend. Buy / sell / launch / snipe / accept payments / collect fees on Pump.fun directly from chat. Reverse-engineered the full pump-fun-agent-payments-sdk: Anchor IDL, PDAs, event parsing, x402 layer — now editable source in the repo. Vanity address grinder (parallel workers, client-side keys). Pump.fun create-coin co-signer. Live pump.fun feed: graduation alerts, GitHub claims, whale buys/sells.
launch_week.none_of_the_metrics_above_happen_without: None of the metrics above happen without something to show. Every feature below is in the repo and reachable from three.ws.
launch_week.note_on_embeds_posts_render_via_x: Note on embeds: Posts render via X's official widgets.js — no API key needed, no auth, no rate limits for read-only embeds. Add or remove tweets by editing the <blockquote> URLs.
launch_week.on_april_29_2026_nichxbt_posted_somethin: On April 29, 2026, @nichxbt posted: "something I've wanted for a while: an AI that isn't just a text box." Attached was the launch of three.ws — the open-source platform for building, embedding, monetizing, and minting 3D AI agents on-chain. Viewer, runtime, identity, payments, marketplace, and a one-line embed — one stack, one repo.
launch_week.one_week_one_brand_new_account_every: One week. One brand-new account. Every interaction below was earned organically — no paid amplification, no bought followers.
launch_week.peak_day_was_may_5_46k_impressions: Peak day was May 5 — 46K impressions, ~1,200 new followers in 24 hours. Driven by the Solana Frontier Hackathon listing (42K views, 621 reposts), the Coinbase + Coinbase Wallet listing of $THREE (12K views), and Jupiter Exchange verification.
launch_week.press_culture_voguemagazine_photo_vogue_: Press + culture: @VogueMagazine Photo Vogue feature, @BuzzFeed profile, @amazonmusic + @Spotify podcast launch. Embed proof shipped into @Shopify.
launch_week.reply_ratio_like_ratio_845_replies_on: Reply ratio > like ratio. 845 replies on 7,200 likes is an 11.7% reply rate — well into "live conversation" territory. The 1,010-member X community is the asset that ratio builds. Likes are sentiment; replies are people who showed up to talk.
launch_week.reply_to_like_ratio_11_7_the: Reply-to-like ratio: 11.7%. The community shows up to talk, not just lurk. That's the number to optimize for in week two.
launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Reputation markets staking on agents' signed action histories, EIP-7710 skill royalties paid to skill authors per-call, and agent-to-agent autonomous payments through delegated signer wallets.
launch_week.ship_daily_name_the_partner_of_the: Ship daily. Name the partner. Of the 64 posts in this window, the highest-engagement ones were either (a) "we just shipped X, here's the link" or (b) "@PartnerName picked us up." Roadmaps and teasers do not exist in the top 20 by views. Every meaningful spike was a real shipped artifact or a real organization saying our name.
launch_week.ship_daily_name_the_partner_reply_ratio: Ship daily. Name the partner. Reply ratio over like ratio. Be a publisher, not a follow-back farm. Cross-pollinate founder voice with brand handle. Crypto X is awake on the weekend — that's when the biggest posts hit.
launch_week.sorted_by_views_every_row_is_a: Sorted by views. Every row is a real scraped post from @trythreews or affiliated authors during the launch window.
launch_week.standards_ai_anthropicai_mcp_registry_pu: Standards + AI: @AnthropicAI MCP Registry, @PulseMCP, W3C membership (proposing a new "3D AI Agents & Identity" Community Group), @Solana Frontier Hackathon via @colosseum.
launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: The <agent-3d> custom element loads lazily on intersection, supports five widget variants (turntable, animation gallery, talking agent, ERC-8004 passport card, hotspot tour), and emits Open Graph and oEmbed metadata so links unfurl with rich previews. A point-and-click Widget Studio generates copy-paste embed code. three.ws Studio is a full in-browser 3D avatar editor — load a GLB, edit skeleton + materials, export. The Marketplace + Skills Marketplace + Agent Reputation system make agents discoverable, monetizable, and rateable. Versioned CDN bundles ship at /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
launch_week.the_flywheel_is_real_apr_29_founder: The flywheel is real. Apr 29 founder launch (135K views) → npm publish + MCP Registry + x402scan listing same day → Google Cloud announcement Apr 30 → Pump.fun skills + reverse-engineered SDK same window → Alibaba + CoinGecko May 2 → Solana Hackathon May 4 (42K views, 621 RTs) → Coinbase + Jupiter + Investing.com all stacked into May 5 (the 46K-impression peak day). One post earns the next.
launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: The Google Cloud announcement was the single highest-engagement post of the week (~6.9K impressions, 263 likes, 24 reposts) and the cloud infrastructure backing the next phase of the platform.
launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: The "Inside The 3D Agent Web" podcast episode is published on Amazon Music and the companion blog "Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body" went out via the Spotify-on-chain ecosystem. Two more distribution surfaces, one more week.
launch_week.the_may_5_peak_46k_impressions_and: The May 5 peak — 46K impressions and roughly 1,200 new followers in 24 hours — was driven by the Solana Frontier Hackathon listing landing, the Coinbase listing announcement, and the Jupiter Exchange verification all dropping in the same window.
launch_week.the_next_web_has_agents_in_it: The next web has agents in it. They need identity, embodiment, and a way to transact. We're building the spec — and the product, the SDK, the marketplace, and the on-chain economy underneath it.
launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: The platform shipped as a partner listing on Alibaba Cloud, our first cloud-marketplace distribution channel. The associated launch tweet pulled ~7.1K impressions on its own.
launch_week.the_post_reached_135_000_views_in: The post reached 135,000 views in under 24 hours. Within a week, @trythreews had gone from a fresh handle to a verified profile with 3,675 followers, three live x402 paid endpoints, two npm-published SDKs, partnerships with Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud, listings on Coinbase, Bybit, Jupiter, CoinGecko, and CoinMarketCap, and an entry in the Solana Frontier Hackathon.
launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: The roadmap closes the gap from "use a 3D artist" to "take a selfie." Four phases, scoped end-to-end in the public README.
launch_week.the_thesis_build_a_real_product_ship: The thesis: Build a real product, ship something every day, name the partners as you land them. The flywheel takes care of the rest.
launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: The three.ws X community is the gathered audience — developers, agent-curious builders, and a crew of folks following along live. It's where the next wave of agent owners will come from.
launch_week.three_live_paid_endpoints_solana_token_t: Three live paid endpoints: /api/x402/mint-to-mesh (Solana token → themed 3D avatar, $0.01 USDC), /api/x402/model-check (paid glTF validator), /api/insights/revenue-vision (Claude-powered agent strategy, $0.001 USDC). Auto-discoverable at /.well-known/x402.json. CDP facilitator with ES256 JWT auth. Multi-network: Base (eip155:8453), Arbitrum (eip155:42161), Solana.
launch_week.three_live_x402_paid_endpoints_mint_to: Three live x402 paid endpoints — mint-to-mesh, model-check, revenue-vision — auto-discoverable at /.well-known/x402.json. Two npm-published SDKs: @three-ws/sdk and @three-ws/agent-payments v3.1. ERC-8004 on-chain identity. ERC-7710 scoped delegations. Solana attestations on six event types.
launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Three selfies (left, center, right), GPU-backed multi-view face reconstruction, and a rigged, animatable avatar minted as a draft ERC-8004 token in under sixty seconds. Mobile-first capture UX with realtime quality gates.
launch_week.three_ws: three.ws
launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws is organized as four communicating layers, plus a backend and a contracts package. Every layer is in production at three.ws and ships as part of the open-source repo. Here's the inventory.
launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws is published as io.github.nirholas/three.ws on registry.modelcontextprotocol.io and discoverable via PulseMCP's curated directory. Any MCP-aware client (Claude Desktop included) can connect and drive avatars over JSON-RPC.
launch_week.we_built_the_platform_that_gives_it: We built the platform that gives it one. In a week: a full 3D AI agent stack — viewer, runtime, on-chain identity, payments, embed, and marketplace — plus two npm SDKs, three live x402 endpoints, partnerships with Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud, listings on Coinbase, Bybit, Jupiter, and CoinGecko, a W3C seat, and a community of 1,010 builders. This is the receipt.
launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: WebGL 2.0 rendering with full glTF 2.0 / GLB support: Draco geometry compression, KTX2 texture compression, Meshopt mesh optimization, HDR environment maps, PBR materials, skinned animation, morph targets, and embedded cameras. Validation is line-level via the Khronos gltf-validator. Lip-sync analyser drives mouth morphs from the agent's voice in real time. Selfie capture + AvatarTurn integration generate playable avatars from a phone camera. Drag-and-drop loading, OrbitControls with configurable auto-rotation, and a real-time dat.GUI for live tweaking.
launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: WebGL viewer, LLM agent runtime, ERC-8004 identity contracts, OAuth 2.1 server, MCP endpoint, and the <agent-3d> web component — everything you read about above. Live at three.ws today.
launch_week.weekend_doesn_t_sleep_the_biggest_single: Weekend doesn't sleep. The biggest single day (May 5) was a Sunday. The biggest single post (Solana Hackathon, 42K views, 621 RTs) hit on a Saturday. Crypto X is awake when most marketing teams aren't. Ship on the weekend.

news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.an_open_source_mcp_server_for_watsonx: An open-source MCP server for watsonx.ai. @three-ws/ibm-watsonx-mcp exposes watsonx.ai — IBM Granite and any model in your account — to any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor) as five tools: chat, text generation, embeddings, tokenization, and model discovery.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.behind_the_3d_body_is_a_brain: Behind the 3D body is a brain — and that brain can run on IBM watsonx.ai. The integration is real, in production, and open source, with no mock path. Two layers connect three.ws to watsonx:
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.both_layers_run_on_your_own_ibm: Both layers run on your own IBM Cloud credentials — an API key is exchanged for a short-lived IAM token and every inference call is scoped to your watsonx.ai project, with no three.ws intermediary between your agent and IBM. A 3D agent embedded on any page can reason on IBM Granite, running inside your own watsonx.ai project, governed by your IBM Cloud account.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.embedding_a_persistent_on_chain_3d_agent: Embedding a persistent, on-chain 3D agent into any platform should be as easy as embedding a YouTube video. One <agent-3d> tag deploys a full agent — no install, no plugin, no native app — rendered in any modern browser over WebGL. What lands on the page is a character with a face, a voice, memory, emotion, and an on-chain identity that persists across platforms. The goal of that frictionless deployment: onboard the next millions of people to embodied AI without asking any of them to download anything.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.meta_description: three.ws and IBM are partners, and we shared a live demo publicly: a persistent, on-chain 3D agent embedded into any page as easily as a YouTube video — thinking on IBM watsonx.ai and Granite. The public /ibm demos are independent developer tools, not official partnership deliverables. The integration ships as an open-source MCP server and a first-class watsonx provider in the three.ws agent runtime, running on your own IBM Cloud credentials.

news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_an_open_source_stack: three.ws is an open-source stack for autonomous 3D AI agents that run natively in the browser. Every <agent-3d> tag deploys an agent with a Solana NFT identity (Metaplex Core), an ERC-8004 wallet on EVM, a browser-native 3D body in WebGL via three.js, a Claude-powered LLM brain, and native x402 / HTTP 402 payments in USDC on Base, BSC, and Solana.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_apache_2_0_from: three.ws is Apache 2.0 from top to bottom — viewer, runtime, identity contracts, backend. AWS customers can audit the entire stack, fork it, and run their own deployment if they want full control. The platform is also already live on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace and listed in BNB Chain Dappbay, the Model Context Protocol Registry, and x402scan — AWS joins a deliberate multi-cloud distribution strategy.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_now_an_aws_partner: three.ws is now an AWS Partner. The platform has been enrolled in the AWS Partner Network (APN) Software Path as a Technology Partner — the official designation for independent software vendors building products for AWS customers.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_the_first_fully_on: three.ws is the first fully on-chain 3D AI agent platform in the AWS Partner Network. Every <agent-3d> tag the platform produces is a Solana-minted, ERC-8004-walleted, x402-payable autonomous actor — and that stack is now part of AWS's partner ecosystem.

news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_s_production_infrastructure_alr: three.ws's production infrastructure already runs on AWS us-east-1 and is registered in AWS MyApplications for unified cost and operations monitoring. The path from "we run on AWS" to "we're an AWS Partner" is the formalization of a technical alignment that's been in production for months.

news_live_on_aws_marketplace.this_is_the_first_fully_on_chain: This is the first fully on-chain AI agent platform listed on AWS Marketplace. Enterprise procurement meets ERC-8004 identity, Metaplex Core on Solana, and native x402 USDC settlement — all in the same purchase flow.

news_live_on_aws_marketplace.three_ws_implements_the_full_aws_marketp: three.ws implements the full AWS Marketplace SaaS contract: ResolveCustomer on the fulfillment URL, signed SNS subscription lifecycle webhooks (subscribe-success, unsubscribe-success, entitlement-updated), daily metered usage via BatchMeterUsage, and contract entitlement checks via GetEntitlements. news_live_on_aws_marketplace.three_ws_is_an_open_source_stack: three.ws is an open-source stack for autonomous 3D AI agents that run natively in the browser. Every <agent-3d> tag deploys an agent with a Solana NFT identity (Metaplex Core), an ERC-8004 wallet on EVM, a browser-native 3D body in WebGL via three.js, a Claude-powered LLM brain, and native x402 / HTTP 402 payments in USDC on Base, BSC, and Solana.
news_live_on_aws_marketplace.three_ws_is_now_live_on_aws: three.ws is now live on AWS Marketplace as a SaaS subscription. news_text_to_3d_is_live.text_3d_runs_a_two_stage_pipeline: Text→3D runs a two-stage pipeline: the prompt is rendered into a reference image by a state-of-the-art image model, then lifted into full textured geometry by TRELLIS, a 3D reconstruction model. The output is a GLB — the open standard that loads in Blender, Unity, Unreal, three.js, and every major 3D tool. Quality tiers (Draft / Standard / High) trade speed for fidelity, and builders with their own Meshy or Tripo API key can plug it in — the key stays in the browser.

oracle_docs.a_coin_s_conviction_time_series_sparklin: A coin's conviction time-series (sparkline data) with a rising/falling/stable trend.

oracle_docs.a_conviction_score_is_a_probabilistic_cl: A conviction score is a probabilistic claim, and a probabilistic claim is worthless unless it's checked against reality. Oracle joins every verdict to its ground-truth outcome and publishes the result on the page — including when the edge is thin. This is the part that separates a model from a vibe.
oracle_docs.a_dynamic_1200_630_opengraph_conviction_: A dynamic 1200×630 OpenGraph conviction card (SVG) for sharing a coin.
oracle_docs.a_hard_ceiling_on_the_final_score: A hard ceiling on the final score, set by a severe structural or pedigree red flag, applied before clamping.
oracle_docs.a_high_score_is_the_weight_of: A high score is the weight of on-chain evidence, not a guarantee. pump.fun is adversarial and heavy-tailed — most launches fail, and even a calibrated edge loses often. Read the tier as odds, size accordingly, and never bet what you can't lose.
oracle_docs.a_long_lived_node_process_running_three: A long-lived Node process running three independent loops — score (keep verdicts warm), agent (act on armed watches), and settle (grade outcomes) — each self-scheduling so a slow pass never blocks a fast one.
oracle_docs.a_model_you_can_only_trust_when: A model you can only trust when it flatters you is useless. Here is what Oracle cannot do, where it can be wrong, and how it's hardened.
oracle_docs.a_pump_fun_coin_that_completed_its: A pump.fun coin that completed its bonding curve — the canonical success event.
oracle_docs.a_pure_side_effect_free_scoring_function: A pure, side-effect-free scoring function (convict()) plus a defensive data-assembly layer. Given a mint, it returns a score, tier, pillar breakdown, and reasons. No I/O during scoring — fully testable.
oracle_docs.a_scored_coin_is_a_win_if: A scored coin is a win if it graduated, or reached a ≥2× ATH multiple without rugging; a loss if it rugged or languished below 1.2×; flat in between. The "without rugging" clause matters: bundled launches routinely spike 2× from first sight before collapsing, and counting those wicks as wins would let pump-and-dumps inflate the very number that's supposed to expose them. Only resolved coins count toward a win rate — open positions are excluded, so the number can't be inflated by undecided bets.
oracle_docs.a_single_long_lived_node_process_runs: A single long-lived Node process runs three independent, self-scheduling loops. They share nothing but the database, so a slow scoring pass never delays an agent acting, and a stuck confirmation never freezes scoring.
oracle_docs.a_single_wallet_s_profile_recent_coins: A single wallet's profile + recent coins, or the wallet leaderboard.
oracle_docs.a_wallet_labelled_smart_money_kol_or: A wallet labelled smart-money/KOL or with a reputation score ≥70 — the pedigree currency.

oracle_docs.alongside_the_score_the_engine_emits_bad: Alongside the score, the engine emits badges (e.g. smart-money, structure-flag, news, momentum, prime) for fast visual scanning, and an ordered list of reasons — each tagged to the pillar that produced it — so the score is never a black box.

oracle_docs.brier_score_the_mean_squared_error_of: Brier score: BS = (1/N) Σ (s_i/100 − y_i)², the mean squared error of the probabilistic claim; decomposable into reliability − resolution + uncertainty.
oracle_docs.buyer_track_record_is_the_single_most: — buyer track record is the single most predictive signal.

oracle_docs.conviction_is_only_half_the_product_the: Conviction is only half the product. The other half is letting a 3D agent act on it — autonomously, within limits you set, grading itself against every outcome. That is what /oracle/arm configures.
oracle_docs.conviction_is_the_weighted_fusion_of_fou: Conviction is the weighted fusion of four independent reads. Each pillar is scored 0–100 on its own, for its own reasons, and contributes a fixed share of the final number.
oracle_docs.conviction_weighted_size_the_executor_th: Conviction-weighted size: size = base · (1 + clamp((score − min)/(100 − min), 0, 1)·0.5). The executor then applies the absolute ceiling: size = min(size, ORACLE_MAX_TRADE_SOL) — a guardian limit that overrides any per-agent setting.

oracle_docs.deeper_social_ingestion_holder_graph_evo: Deeper social ingestion, holder-graph evolution over time, cross-coin creator/funder linkage, and order-flow microstructure are all additive pillars or sub-signals under the same fusion contract.
oracle_docs.does_prime_actually_beat_blind_buying_th: Does prime actually beat blind buying? The page reports prime's win rate, the lift over the base rate, the edge multiple, and whether win rate rises monotonically across tiers.
oracle_docs.each_tier_s_realized_win_rate_is: Each tier's realized win rate is shown with a 95% Wilson confidence interval — the right tool for win-rate estimates on small samples, where a naïve ± would lie. A wide band means "not enough data yet," and the page says so.
oracle_docs.every_action_an_agent_takes_simulated_or: Every action an agent takes — simulated or live — is graded against ground truth and lands in its permanent win-rate ledger. This is what makes an agent's track record verifiable instead of asserted.
oracle_docs.every_field_here_is_also_available_progr: Every field here is also available programmatically from GET /api/oracle/coin?mint=… — see the API reference.
oracle_docs.every_new_wallet_judged_and_every_new: Every new wallet judged and every new launch resolved sharpens the WHO pillar and tightens the bands. The data flywheel is the moat — coverage compounds into calibration.
oracle_docs.every_one_of_those_facts_is_on: Every one of those facts is on-chain or one inference away from it. The bottleneck has never been availability — it is assembly and speed. No human watches every wallet across every launch and fuses it into a decision in seconds. A machine can.
oracle_docs.every_scored_coin_as_a_glowing_sphere: Every scored coin as a glowing sphere in a force-directed, category-clustered 3D field; size and color encode conviction and tier.
oracle_docs.every_section_opens_in_plain_english_wha: Every section opens in plain English: what it is, why it exists, and how to use it. If you only read the prose, you will understand the whole system and never see a formula you didn't ask for.
oracle_docs.everything_on_the_page_is_a_public: Everything on the page is a public endpoint. Reads are JSON, cached at the CDN and rate-limited per IP; live views are Server-Sent Events. Agent-config endpoints require auth scoped to the agent owner.
oracle_docs.finds_open_actions_whose_coin_now_has: Finds open actions whose coin now has a resolved outcome, grades each win/loss/flat, marks PnL to market, and closes the learning loop.
oracle_docs.finds_recent_launches_that_are_new_or: Finds recent launches that are new or stale (last scored >3 min ago), scores each — assemble → classify → fuse → persist — and appends history on material change. Keeps the cache warm.
oracle_docs.five_brain_tables_feed_every_score_oracl: Five brain tables feed every score. Oracle queries each one defensively — a missing or younger table degrades the affected pillar gracefully rather than failing the whole verdict.
oracle_docs.for_each_armed_watch_evaluates_freshly_s: For each armed watch, evaluates freshly-scored coins against the agent's bar and budget, executes a buy when the gates pass, and fires alerts. Dedups so an agent never acts twice on one coin.
oracle_docs.for_every_armed_agent_on_every_freshly: For every armed agent, on every freshly-scored coin, a pure decision function runs a sequence of gates. If any gate blocks, the agent passes; if all clear, it sizes and buys.
oracle_docs.for_wins_in_resolved_coins_the_95: For w wins in n resolved coins, the 95% Wilson score interval (z = 1.96) is:
oracle_docs.full_intel_for_one_mint_conviction_pilla: Full intel for one mint — conviction, pillars, reasons, narrative, outcome, and the who's-in trader roster. Scores fresh (with LLM) on a cache miss.
oracle_docs.global_kpis_per_category_intel_symbol_se: Global KPIs, per-category intel, symbol search, the agent leaderboard, a single agent's record, and the global action feed.
oracle_docs.go_straight_to_the_edge_win_rate: Go straight to The edge. Win rate by tier with 95% confidence bands, a calibration ladder, and a Brier score — shown even when the edge is thin. Proof, not promises.
oracle_docs.here_is_the_coin_drawer_the_product: Here is the coin drawer the product shows when you click any launch. It is the score, fully unpacked — the same object the API returns, rendered for a human.
oracle_docs.how_closely_realized_win_rates_match_the: How closely realized win rates match the scores that predicted them.
oracle_docs.if_the_conviction_cache_is_empty_fresh: If the conviction cache is empty (fresh deploy), the feed endpoint scores a handful of recent coins on the spot — database-only, no LLM — so the UI is never blank while the score loop catches up. Every brain query is wrapped so a missing table yields a null slice, not a crashed pass.

oracle_docs.it_is_a_probability_not_a_prophecy: It is a probability, not a prophecy

oracle_docs.let_a_launch_be_a_feature_vector: Let a launch be a feature vector x. Oracle computes four pillar functions f_k(x) ∈ [0,100] for k ∈ {ped, str, nar, mom}, a weighted score, and a capped, clamped output:
oracle_docs.lifecycle_a_coin_must_be_actually_first: Lifecycle: a coin must be ≥… actually first-seen and within a 12h window to enter scoring; it's scored, classified, and cached; rescored when stale (every ~3 min if new data arrives); its history appended on material change; quote/stablecoin mints (USDC, wSOL, …) are excluded and purged. Nothing about a score decays purely with time — the engine is event-driven, reacting to new wallet activity, not a clock.
oracle_docs.live_conviction_feed_scored_coins_with_p: Live conviction feed — scored coins with pillars, badges, category, sparkline; plus a tier-level backtest summary. Filters: tier, category, min_score, limit, network.

Fused live across DexScreener, pump.fun, GeckoTerminal, GoPlus, Birdeye and CoinGecko.
oracle_docs.live_routing_builds_buy_instructions_via: Live routing builds buy instructions via the pump SDK with 10% slippage, fetches a fresh blockhash, and either sends a raw transaction (skip-preflight off, up to 3 retries, 60s confirm race) or, when Jito is enabled, prepends a small tip transfer to a rotating tip account and submits the pair as a bundle to the block-engine endpoint. The action is written as filled with the signature (or jito:<bundleId>), skipped if the agent has no wallet, or failed on any on-chain error — never silently dropped.
oracle_docs.live_trades_streams_the_coin_s_buys: Live trades streams the coin's buys and sells in real time, each annotated with the trader's wallet archetype.
oracle_docs.loss_the_coin_rugged_or_marked_below: Loss — the coin rugged, or marked below 0.5× / peaked below 1.2×. Loss conditions outrank a peak-based win: a 2× wick on a position now at zero was exit liquidity, not a win.
oracle_docs.machine_ready_a_buy_watch_skip_recommend: Machine-ready. A buy/watch/skip recommendation with confidence and a size factor, per mint or as the top N plays — built for agent polling.
